records.claim_text: BrightPay’s current UK migration page declares Desktop retirement for 2026/27 and offers separate in-house and bureau Cloud routes. Retaining the supplier can still involve a new product, subscription and migration.
records.locator: Main 2026/27 statement; migration paths and end-of-life FAQ
records.limitations: A supplier offer does not select the best alternative, prove legal necessity to buy its Cloud product, complete feature parity or actual employer migration.
records.review_mode: Relevant current BrightPay migration hub original HTML inspected and retained. No product trial, actual customer migration or customer contract inspection.
